brief: Design an interface for a "Time Decay Radio" that lets users tune into conversations from the past, where audio fragments from different decades literally deteriorate and blend together based on how far back you scroll—imagine a vertical timeline where 1920s jazz broadcasts crackle and fragment into visual waveforms that users can physically stretch and compress to isolate specific moments, with the UI elements themselves (buttons, text, borders) also degrading and reforming to match the era bei
critique: The design suffers from an identity crisis between retro radio aesthetics and modern UI, with the orange tube glow clashing against the green waveform accent. The spatial hierarchy is confused with oversized frequency display dominating while the timeline feels cramped, and the minimal motion design fails to enhance the time-travel concept.
fixes: Remove 80% of visual effects - keep only essential tube glow on frequency display and eliminate static overlay, multiple gradients, and competing animations
Establish clear visual hierarchy by using consistent spacing system (8px grid) and limiting to 3 font sizes max with stronger contrast ratios
Redesign timeline as clean vertical strips with subtle opacity changes instead of heavy gradients, using interaction states to reveal detail

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Time Decay Radio</title>
    <style>
        :root {
            --primary-bg: #0a0a0c;
            --secondary-bg: #1a1a1c;
            --tube-glow: #ff9500;
            --text-primary: #f2f2f7;
            --text-secondary: #8e8e93;
            --accent-green: #34c759;
            --track-bg: #2a2a2c;
            --spacing-unit: 8px;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;
            background: var(--primary-bg);
            width: 1440px;
            height: 900px;
            overflow: hidden;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .radio-container {
            width: 1200px;
            height: 720px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: calc(var(--spacing-unit) * 4);
        }

        .radio-chassis {
            background: var(--secondary-bg);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: calc(var(--spacing-unit) * 4);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            height: 200px;
        }

        .frequency-section {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: calc(var(--spacing-unit) * 2);
        }

        .frequency-display {
            position: relative;
            padding: calc(var(--spacing-unit) * 2);
        }

        .frequency-glow {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            width: 200px;
            height: 80px;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, var(--tube-glow) 0%, transparent 60%);
            opacity: 0.3;
            filter: blur(40px);
        }

        .frequency-readout {
            font-size: 64px;
            font-weight: 200;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
            letter-spacing: 0.02em;
            color: var(--tube-glow);
            text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 149, 0, 0.4);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .decade-indicator {
            font-size: 14px;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            padding-left: calc(var(--spacing-unit) * 2);
        }

        .waveform-viewport {
            flex: 1;
            margin-left: calc(var(--spacing-unit) * 8);
            background: var(--primary-bg);
            border-radius: 8px;
